webhookDescription: Send track data to a webhook URL when playback reaches the specified percentage
useArtistInStatusLine: Display artist name instead of application name
richPresencePreviewDescription: Show a live preview of your Discord Rich Presence in the settings panel
trackParserDescription: Parse track titles to extract artist and track names automatically
customThemeDescription: Place .css files in the themes folder to customize the SoundCloud UI
pluginsDescription: Place .js plugin files in the plugins folder to extend functionality
showDownloadButton: Show download button in the title bar
downloadUseAccount: Download as my SoundCloud account (Go+ and original files)
ytDlpPath: yt-dlp path (leave empty to find it automatically)
downloadsDescription: Downloads need yt-dlp installed, plus ffmpeg for covers and tags, and keep the audio as SoundCloud serves it. The file name and folder are yt-dlp output templates; leave the folder empty to save straight into the download folder.
deemixPath: deemix path (leave empty to use YouTube)
downloadDrmFallbackDescription: DRM-protected tracks can't come from SoundCloud, so they are fetched from YouTube instead, at lower quality. Set the path to deemix to try Deezer first; it must already be signed in.
installerCleanupDetail: The installer disk is still mounted. Eject it and move {file} to the Trash?
